rules.title: RevenueDot Purchases Hybrid Common
rules.description: Shared native and TypeScript layer under RevenueDot's React Native, Flutter, Capacitor, Unity and Cordova SDKs, forked from RevenueCat's MIT purchases-hybrid-common.
rules: Do not install this package directly: install the RevenueDot React Native, Flutter, Capacitor, Unity or Cordova SDK, which pull it in.
Configure the wrapper SDK, not this layer: its `setProxyURL` and `configure` calls pass through to RevenueDot's native iOS and Android SDKs.
It publishes CocoaPods RevenueDotPurchasesHybridCommon and RevenueDotPurchasesHybridCommonUI, and Maven Central {{mavenGroup}}:purchases-hybrid-common.

The npm packages are {{npmScope}}/purchases-typescript-internal, {{npmScope}}/purchases-typescript-internal-esm and {{npmScope}}/purchases-js-hybrid-mappings, installed through npm aliases by the wrappers.
RevenueDot Cloud ({{apiHost}}) is the default API host; a self-hosted server is set with the wrapper SDK's `setProxyURL`.

rules.note: native iOS from our fork (RevenueCat uses a separate SPM mirror repo)
the ESM flavour is renamed at release time

rules.title: RevenueDot Purchases Hybrid Common
install: You never install this package yourself. It is the shared native and TypeScript layer under the RevenueDot [React Native](https://github.com/{{org}}/react-native-purchases), [Flutter](https://github.com/{{org}}/purchases-flutter), [Capacitor](https://github.com/{{org}}/purchases-capacitor), [Unity](https://github.com/{{org}}/purchases-unity) and [Cordova](https://github.com/{{org}}/cordova-plugin-purchases) SDKs, which pull it in. Version {{version}} is published as:
| Swift Package Manager | `https://github.com/{{org}}/{{repo}}` at `{{version}}{{gitTagSuffix}}` | same products |
| npm | `{{npmScope}}/purchases-typescript-internal`, `-esm`, `{{npmScope}}/purchases-js-hybrid-mappings` | installed through npm aliases by the wrappers |

code: // Configure the wrapper SDK, not this package: its setProxyURL and configure calls pass through this layer
// to RevenueDot's native iOS and Android SDKs, which already carry RevenueDot's host and signing key.

adds: **RevenueDot's native SDKs all the way down:** this layer pins RevenueDot's [iOS](https://github.com/{{org}}/purchases-ios), [Android](https://github.com/{{org}}/purchases-android) and [web](https://github.com/{{org}}/purchases-js) forks, so a wrapper built on it never talks to RevenueCat.

**Start for free on [RevenueDot Cloud](https://app.revenuedot.app/signup)**: free until your apps make $10,000 a month, then 0.5%, never more than $999 a month ([pricing](https://revenuedot.app/pricing)).
**The same REST API and webhook payloads** as RevenueCat, so your backend and integrations keep working ([API reference](https://revenuedot.app/docs/api)).

pins.note: the native iOS release this hybrid-common release was built against
the native Android release this hybrid-common release was built against
follows our purchases-js fork, which may be newer than upstream's pin

checks.name: podspec parse
checks.run: for f in RevenueDotPurchasesHybridCommon.podspec RevenueDotPurchasesHybridCommonUI.podspec; do LANG=en_US.UTF-8 pod ipc spec "$f" 2>/dev/null | node -e 'const s=JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync(0,"utf8"));console.log(s.name,"module",s.module_name,"tag",s.source.tag,"deps",JSON.stringify(s.dependencies||{}))' || exit 1; done

checks.name: typescript: build + jest
checks.run: cd typescript && npm install --no-audit --no-fund --silent && npx tsc --noEmit && npx jest --silent 2>&1 | tail -6

checks.name: purchases-js-hybrid-mappings: typecheck + jest (purchases-js alias resolved to the same upstream version; set LOCAL_PURCHASES_JS=<built fork> to use ours)
checks.run: cd purchases-js-hybrid-mappings && node $FORKS_DIR/lib/unalias.mjs package.json && npm install --no-audit --no-fund --silent && npx tsc --noEmit -p . && npx jest --silent 2>&1 | tail -6
